title.value: Deep learning prediction of response to disease modifying therapy in primary progressive multiple sclerosis
title.justification: The title directly refers to the study's focus on using deep learning to predict responses to therapy in multiple sclerosis patients.
title.quote: Deep learning prediction of response to disease modifying therapy in primary progressive multiple sclerosis

extractions.description: This paper explores the application of deep learning models to predict which individuals with primary progressive multiple sclerosis (PPMS) will respond favorably to disease-modifying therapies (DMTs) based on baseline clinical and imaging characteristics. The study involves using data from clinical trials and establishing a model to identify potential responders, enabling predictive enrichment in clinical trials to require fewer participants.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The study focuses on medical applications, specifically predicting therapy responses in multiple sclerosis, without direct mention of climate or ecological sustainable development aspects.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Individuals with PPMS who respond favourably to DMTs can be identified using deep learning based on their baseline clinical and imaging characteristics.
